pilot.scope: development-only error, fidelity, memory and complete-update timing check; validation only; no test evaluation

reporting.scope: complete bounded early-training fidelity/cost/memory demonstration; not convergence or quality superiority

optimizer: SGD momentum0.9; all original private-head gradients unweighted; no clipping/scheduler
model: frozen CelebA v2 Model: ImageNet1K_V1 ResNet18 shared trunk;40 linear binary heads; fixed pretrained BN statistics and frozen BN affine; evaluation mode
loss: 40 simultaneous shared-minibatch attribute BCE means; shared trunk weighted, private heads receive own unweighted gradient
initialization: fresh paired initialization by new seed, pretrained trunk and newly initialized heads; compare initial_model_sha256 across all four arms
data: same frozen 16000 official-train subset,4000 official-validation subset, full official test;64x64 RGB PIL bilinear and existing ImageNet preprocessing
learning_rate_source: existing frozen Direct development-selected LR .02; no new LR search; identical for every arm
pairing: same seed and torch.Generator.manual_seed(seed*100000+step) sample order with replacement; all128 sample indices and hashes retained per step
stream_policy: start from uniform each update; identical retained stable_recovery acquisition, upper-span solver and lower-completion QP machinery. Completion versus positive-part scalar stopping only; scalar is an endpoint ablation, not an optimized scalar-only algorithm.
failure_policy: Record every attempted action/prefix/error; failed or unaccepted Stream recovery/reconstruction incurs explicit timed Direct fallback. Direct/native control failures and independent audit failures halt and quarantine the run; no omitted seeds or cells.
raw_traces: Every attempted query vector and response, every upper endpoint/weight/response, every lower-completion QP result, retained stopping history, executed weights, native audit records and per-update losses. Intermediate solver failure prefixes remain marked incomplete.
audits: At pre-update states0,updates//2,updates-1; inspect the actual emitted shared gradient, separate unweighted head convention and emitted objective against independently acquired native task gradients. Relative reference must be resolved. Failed audit halts; does not silently become a fallback.
primary_endpoint: final300-update worst-attribute test accuracy; paired Stream-completion minus each matched arm, descriptive three-seed differences only
co_primary_engineering: independently achieved fidelity, complete-update elapsed time, total and incremental training allocation including real SGD momentum/update buffers; all fallback and failed-query counts
secondary: all40 attribute accuracy, balanced accuracy and BCE; means/worst; final full validation and reporting-only test metrics. No validation checkpoint selection.
numerical_scope: FP32 model/AD/emitted gradients;FP64 contraction/QP diagnostics. No outward full-AD certificate; momentum update has no common-descent guarantee.
update_timing: CUDA-synchronized preprocessing/transfer,recovery,head gradients,finite checks and actual SGD. On audited steps recovery and optimizer segments surround an untimed independent audit; peak is maximum of the two measured segments. Audit allocations released before optimizer/next-step peak reset.
wall_timing: Separate main-entry active-attempt wall includes setup, data loading, audits, evaluation, earlier snapshots and event writes. Excludes imports and final manifest write. Interrupted tails remain explicitly unrecorded; orphan events and their work retained.
persistence: one atomically replaced latest checkpoint every25updates and final; immutable attempt-specific update JSONs; preserve uncommitted attempt events after restart; no Drive/archive lifecycle

budget_estimate.scope: planning estimate from completed fixed-state recovery; excludes extra head/optimizer work,audits,evaluation,persistence and runtime variation; freeze final allowance after complete four-arm pilot

freeze_conditions: Independent source/CPU audit of driver and protocol.
Explicitly enable pilot only; all four pilot arms must finish with all three native audits passing and complete traces/fallback accounting.
Review complete-update timings and peak allocation with true optimizer state; do not tune to pilot validation/test quality.
Freeze reporting budget/source/protocol identities before enabling any reporting seed; keep all12 outcomes regardless of performance.
cpu_fixture_scope: toy model checks all4 recovery arms, native shared/head parity, actual momentum SGD, exact CPU restart, failed action and nonfinite reconstruction with timed Direct fallback; no GPU test
